final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), cross_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM regional) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - c.mean_avg) AS mean_excess FROM regional r CROSS JOIN cross_mean c WHERE r.avg_amount > c.mean_avg
